facts.fact: Orange Maroc says AWS Wavelength compute and storage is deployed in its Casablanca data centre, so customers can store and process data in Morocco and pay in dirhams (interview; zone live by February 2025).

Orange Maroc states its Casablanca data centre hosting the AWS Wavelength zone meets Tier III Design and Facilities standards (operator statement; no certifier named); date is the article's publication date.

systems.owner: Amazon Web Services with Orange Maroc
